Two planets in her chart never left home. Look what she built with them.

5 APR 1996 · VIRAJPET, KARNATAKA

TL;DR

Nobody had to fight this chart. That's the whole point.

Jupiter runs growth, luck and expansion. Venus runs charm, love and being liked. In her kundli, both sit in their own sign — full native strength, no compromises.
That's genuinely rare. Most charts hand you one strong planet and make you earn the rest. She got two of the best ones — the ambition planet and the relationship planet — both at home, both running since birth.

And the public record backs it up: a small-town Kannada-cinema debutante with no producer parent or industry family became a three-language, pan-India lead actress in about six years. Not really a comeback story. A compounding one.

Real talk

The two things people actually search for

One's ugly, one's happy. Both are public record, and we're not pretending the chart has special insight into either.

🛑 The deepfake video, November 2023
What's public

A digitally manipulated video morphed her face onto unrelated footage of a different creator and went viral, widely mistaken for genuine. She called it "extremely scary" — for herself and for anyone vulnerable to the same misuse — and pushed publicly for a nationwide conversation on deepfake accountability.

Delhi Police later arrested a suspect. Amitabh Bachchan and several other actors publicly backed her at the time.

What the chart notes

Her Sun antardasha (Jun 2023–Apr 2024) was running through this. Sun periods are classically read as maximum-visibility stretches — this happened to be the same few months as Animal's release.

To be clear: that's a coincidence of timing, not a cause. No chart makes someone a target of a crime, and none is implied here.

💍 The relationship nobody confirmed for eight years
What's public

Dating rumours linking her to Vijay Deverakonda go back to their Geetha Govindam days in 2018. Neither confirmed anything publicly for years. They married in February 2026.

"Is Rashmika Mandanna manglik" and "Vijay Deverakonda kundli matching" are both real, frequently-asked searches — addressed honestly in the FAQ below.

What the chart notes

They first worked together during her Jupiter–Mercury antardasha (2017–19) — the same stretch that opened her Telugu career. The wedding itself landed years later, right at the tail of Jupiter–Mars.

Good timing, presented as texture — not a rule anyone should bet on.

Being straight with you: nothing above is a claim about why anything actually happened. Facts are public record; the astrology alongside them is traditional interpretation, offered for entertainment — never a verdict, never a cause, and never a house-level analysis of anyone's marriage or safety. We don't do that on any page.
Long shots that landed

Two things that had no obvious reason to work

🌄 → 🌏  No industry family, three industries anyway

  • Grew up in Virajpet, a small town in Kodagu (Coorg), Karnataka — no actor or director parent, no producer relative, no launch vehicle.
  • Studied at M.S. Ramaiah College in Bengaluru before a talent-search win pulled her toward acting.
  • Inside about six years: lead actress across Kannada, Telugu and Hindi cinema, plus a wide Tamil-dub following on top of that.

🔭 The chart bit: Jupiter, on home ground, running the entire stretch — the classic "the door genuinely keeps opening" signature. Not luck exactly. Just a planet with nothing standing in its own way.

📵 → 📢  Turned a violation into a policy conversation

  • The 2023 deepfake incident could have stayed a frightening week that nobody outside her circle heard about.
  • Instead, her public statement — plus the backing from Amitabh Bachchan and others — became one of the most-cited Indian examples in the real policy conversation about deepfake law that followed.
  • The suspect behind the specific video was arrested by Delhi Police.

🔭 The chart bit: honestly, none needed. That response was hers, not her chart's.

Astrology, but make it make sense

LESSON 01

What a birth chart even is

It's a photo of the sky from the exact spot and second someone was born — where every planet was sitting, frozen.

Vedic astrology treats that snapshot as the raw material you were handed, not your fate — your starting kit.

Hers: 5 April 1996, Virajpet, Karnataka. That sky had Jupiter in Sagittarius and Venus in Taurus — both in their own sign. Those two do most of the talking on this page.

LESSON 03

Why "which sign" actually matters

Every planet has signs where it's comfortable and signs where it struggles. Same planet, different room.

  • Home ground (own sign) — the planet owns the place. Full strength, no permission needed.
  • A cluster (stellium) — several planets sharing one sign, like her four in Pisces. Not automatically good or bad — just a lot of weight in one room.
  • Everywhere else — a guest. Functional, not special.
Her scorecard: two planets on home ground (Jupiter, Venus), four sharing Pisces (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Ketu), one in flux (Mercury), one elsewhere (Moon in Libra). Most people get zero home-ground planets. She got two of the most useful ones for a public career.
LESSON 04

The Mercury problem — how we found the exact crossing minute

Signs barely move across a single day — except right at a boundary, where a planet can cross from one sign into the next between one hour and the next.

Rashmika Mandanna's Mercury does exactly this on her birth day. We ran the chart for 5 April 1996 in one-minute steps through the morning to find the moment it happens.

What we found: Mercury sits at 29°59′ Pisces at 07:05 AM IST and crosses into 0°00′ Aries by 07:06 AM IST. Neatly, that same instant is also a nakshatra boundary — the last pada of Revati handing straight to the first pada of Ashwini, because 0° Aries is one of the rare points where a sign boundary and a nakshatra boundary land together.

So: born before roughly 7:05 AM, her Mercury is late Pisces, Revati nakshatra. Born at or after roughly 7:06 AM, it's Aries, Ashwini nakshatra — the placement used everywhere else on this page. We picked Aries because it's the majority-of-day basis: it holds for about 17 of the day's 24 hours, against roughly 7 for Pisces. Every other graha in her chart is identical across the full 24 hours — Mercury is the only placement this page treats as conditional.
LESSON 05

Dashas — why timing is the whole game

Planets don't all act at once. Vedic astrology has them take turns running your life, for years at a stretch, in a fixed order. A planet's turn is a dasha.

Her turns, computed:
Rahu 1996–2012 · Jupiter 2012–2028 · Saturn 2028–2047

Her entire public career — the debut, the crossover, the pan-India jump, the wedding — has happened inside one 16-year Jupiter mahadasha that still has two years left to run.
LESSON 06

Sub-periods — the chapters inside the chapter

A 16-year stretch is too blunt to be useful on its own, so it splits into shorter antardashas, each handed to a different planet. That's where the year-to-year story lives.

Inside her Jupiter mahadasha:
Jupiter–Jupiter (2012–15) → Fresh Face title, run-up to debut
Jupiter–Saturn (2015–17) → Kirik Party debut
Jupiter–Mercury (2017–19) → Telugu crossover
Jupiter–Ketu (2019–20) → short, quiet stretch
Jupiter–Venus (2020–23) → pan-India breakout, Bollywood debut
Jupiter–Sun (2023–24) → Animal, and the deepfake incident
Jupiter–Moon (2024–25) → Pushpa 2, Chhaava
Jupiter–Mars (2025–26) → the wedding
Jupiter–Rahu (2026–28) → current, just over a month old as of this page

Notice which sub-lord ran her biggest crossover: Venus, her other home-ground planet. Best planet, best years — not a coincidence you have to squint at.
LESSON 07

What we genuinely can't tell you

Here's where a lot of celebrity astrology content quietly cheats, and we won't.

A chart has two halves. Which sign each planet is in — that only needs the date (and, for Mercury here, the near-minute — see Lesson 04). And the houses, including the rising sign, which need the exact minute of birth.

No birth time for Rashmika Mandanna has ever been published. Astrological databases list her as Rodden rating "X" — unverified, no source at all — so we don't use one.

So on this page you will not see us say "her marriage house" or "her career house" — that would be a guess dressed as a fact. Other sites will. Ask them which birth time they used, and where it came from.
LESSON 08

So — is Rashmika Mandanna manglik?

One of the most-searched questions about her right now, thanks to the wedding — and the honest answer is unsatisfying.

"Manglik" (mangal dosha) depends on which house Mars occupies — 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th or 12th, by different traditions. Houses need the birth minute. Hers has never been published.

What we can say: her Mars sits in Pisces, a neutral sign — that part holds no matter what time she was born. Whether it lands in a manglik house genuinely cannot be answered from anything public. Any site giving you a confident yes or no for her has picked a birth time from nowhere and isn't telling you that.
LESSON 09

How to actually read that chart square

The grid earlier on this page is a South-Indian chart, the easiest of the three regional styles to learn because the signs never move.

Twelve boxes around the edge, one per zodiac sign, always in the same places. Pisces top-left, then clockwise across the top, down the right side, back across the bottom, and up the left. Memorise the ring once and you can read any South-Indian chart for the rest of your life.

Try it: find the box marked SAG. Whatever symbol sits in it was in Sagittarius at the moment of birth — for her, that's Jupiter, on home ground. You just read a kundli.
LESSON 10

Retrograde, without the drama

A word that gets thrown around a lot and sounds far worse than it is.

Retrograde means a planet appeared to move backwards across the sky. It isn't actually reversing — it's an optical effect of Earth overtaking it in orbit, the way a slower car seems to slide backwards when you pass it. Traditionally it makes a planet's themes more internal and slower to show results.

Hers: Rahu and Ketu, both retrograde — which is completely normal. The lunar nodes are retrograde essentially all the time by the standard calculation; it's not a special flag on her chart specifically.

Not a disaster either way. Anyone selling you a "remedy" for a retrograde node is selling you something.
LESSON 11

What this can and can't tell you

Worth being blunt, since this page has spent a while treating a chart as a serious object.

  • It can describe tendencies, and it can time long stretches — that part is arithmetic. Two astrologers with the same birth data compute the same periods.
  • It can't tell you what someone does with those tendencies. Plenty of people share a Jupiter-in-Sagittarius placement without becoming a pan-India actor.
  • It definitely can't explain, predict or excuse a real event — a deepfake, a relationship, a film flopping or landing. Anyone offering that certainty is guessing with confidence.
The honest framing: a chart describes raw material and weather. It is not a script, and nothing on this page should be read as one.

FAQ 02

What is Rashmika Mandanna's zodiac sign and nakshatra?

Her Moon — the sign most Vedic "rashi" answers actually mean — sits in Libra, in the Swati nakshatra. Her Sun sits in Pisces, Revati nakshatra. The full birth chart is above; every position is computed, not copied.

FAQ 03

It can't be answered honestly without her birth time. Manglik status depends on which house Mars occupies, and no verified birth minute exists for her — her Mars sign (Pisces, neutral) is the only sign-level fact anyone can responsibly state. See Lesson 08 for the full explanation.
